ModMetaData.name: Arcanum Ascendant - Magic & Classes
ModMetaData.author: onionboyo
ModMetaData.description:
A deep magic and class system for RimWorld. No other mods required (no Harmony needed).
[ 9 CLASSES · 27 SUBCLASSES · 207 SPELLS · 658 SKILL TREE NODES ]
Awaken a colonist's magic and choose a path: - Pyromancer: Inferno Lord, Ashen Phoenix, Forgeheart - Tempest: Stormcaller, Frostwarden, Skybreaker - Necromancer: Lich, Bonelord, Plaguebringer - Paladin: Templar, Cleric, Inquisitor - Chronomancer: Timeweaver, Voidwalker, Paradox - Druid: Beastmaster, Verdant Warden, Shapeshifter - Runesmith: Golemancer, Spellforger, Arcane Gunslinger - Shadowmancer: Assassin, Hexer, Hemomancer - Spellsinger: Skald, Illusionist, Jester
FEATURES - Five attributes (Potency, Focus, Celerity, Resilience, Attunement) that gate deeper skill tree rows. - Every class and subclass has its own skill tree: spells, augments that change how spells work, multi-rank passives, mutually exclusive keystones and an ultimate. - Level 50 cap plus endless paragon levels. - Mana and an arcane ward that absorbs damage. - Endgame spells built to fight heavily armored mods: true damage, % vitality damage, executes, shield-shattering, mechanoid shutdown, black holes, time stop, mind control. - Utility and quirky spells: make it rain, clear toxic fallout, turn rocks into silver or steel, enrich soil, grow crops, tame animals, recruit prisoners, speak with the dead, turn back age, polymorph raiders into chickens, custard pies. - Summons: risen dead, wolves, bears, a thrumbo, megascarabs, turrets, golem constructs, walls of ice, bone and thorns. - Custom visual effects (projectiles with trails, beams, chain lightning, meteors, pillars of light, rune circles, shockwaves, black holes) and custom sound effects. - Autocast for drafted mages, enemy mages in raids, a grimoire UI with zoomable skill trees, a spellbook and a codex. - Fully configurable in mod settings.
Safe to add to existing saves.
